invariant: Repository access, identity, contribution, governance, and essential network participation work fully without a token, blockchain, reward system, or speculative asset.

requirements.statement: Canonical repository, identity, authorization, discovery, and governance modules do not import an incentive or payment adapter.
Adapter hooks invoked from canonical writes are optional and cannot fail the canonical write.
Removing every adapter table leaves canonical tables and their foreign keys unchanged.
Canonical tables carry no wallet, balance, token, stake, tip, bounty, or reward column other than documented retired blanks.
Identity, authorization, ranking, moderation, and governance decisions do not read asset ownership or transaction history.
An unconfigured payment adapter answers an explicit not-configured result instead of blocking a canonical response.
The commercial contract and protocol specification publish the invariant, and every optional incentive documents a no-payment path.
